# Instructions for developing a model for air quality forecasting for cities with many industrial sources

1. Start with the data.
2. Include the following factors as variables in the model:
   * particulate matter levels
   * temperature
   * precipitation amount
   * wind speed
   * pollution-causing industries present in the city
   * solar radiation
   * humidity
3. Use a regression analysis to develop the model.
4. Use the model to forecast air quality for the next week.
5. Include instructions for users to use the model to help them make better decisions about how to reduce air pollution.
6. Include a section on how to get real-time air quality data for cities.
7. Include instructions for users to report suspicious-looking air quality data.
8. Include instructions for users to report any bugs or suggestions they have for the model.
